_comment: The standing output format for enriched lead pulls. Use with --column-map so
every scrape produces the same columns in the same order:
website is filled by Apollo's free lookup when BBB's profile page 403s.
apollo_org_id carries forward so the people-match can scope to the right
company instead of matching on a name string.
Columns the scrape cannot fill at all (owner name, email, CRM status) are
added by the Apollo people-match and HubSpot passes afterwards -- they are
listed in enrichment_columns so the two halves stay in one documented shape.
employees is among them: Apollo only filters headcount at its own bucket
edges (1-10, 11-50, ...) and silently ignores any other range, so the >=5
rule is applied from the headcount returned by the paid people-match.
